Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Money, work & business · Town, shops & places

agency noun

a business or office that acts for others

also agencies, travel agency, news agency, employment agency, estate agency

modern

Traupman 219: sēdēs periēgētica, travel agency
M-O s.v. news agency: sēdēs nūntiīs dīvulgandīs (Egger)

sēdēs, sēdis f.

noun, third declension, with an adjective or a gerundive

an agency, an office: sēdēs periēgētica, a travel agency

Classically a seat or an abode; Traupman and Egger use it for an office that does business, with an adjective or a gerundive for the business. The agent himself is a prōcūrātor (see travel agent).

See also travel agent, centre, office, organization.

SourcesLewis & Short: sedes · Lewis & Short: procurator

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: news agency.

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 219, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).
